recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7982 unless a future work group decision changes the broader Resource identity guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7982 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core BaseResource change request from the 2015 May ballot asking for a simple example, or a search-page reference, showing how to access a resource by business identifier rather than literal resource id.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in svn revision 6470, represented in git by commit 44678b91a83be57e235d3b20250fa36a6314ceb4, which added an HL7 v2 OBR-to-DiagnosticReport identifier search example to source/resource/resource-notes.xml.
additional_context: Resource is active resource infrastructure in source/fhir.ini, and the current Resource notes still explain that resources with an identifier element support identifier search, including GET [base]/DiagnosticReport?identifier=1045813. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already satisfies the applied Jira resolution.
